name: Insurance Commissioner of California

constituents.basis: 2020 Census resident population of California (whole state)

powers.value: Leads the California Department of Insurance, which oversees the insurance industry and is charged with protecting insurance consumers.

notes: The term limit comes from the Assembly Clerk's general statement covering all statewide officers; the specific statute (Insurance Code sec. 12900) was not seen. The department-wide budget was not found. The 2026-27 Governor's Budget (ebudget 0845, primary) shows program 0520 (Regulation of Insurance Companies and Insurance Producers) at about $125.5M and 470 positions in 2025-26. That is one program, not the whole department, and it is funded by insurer fees in the Insurance Fund. Prior salary rate was $193,835 (Dec. 2, 2024). An undated 'salary reduction' line of $139,189 appeared in a CalHR snippet; ignore it unless verified. graph.civlab.org: not reachable.
